name: Close Button
description: A round button with a cross that turns a quarter turn on hover, for dismissing banners, tags and dialogs.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ghost is transparent until hovered. Filled rests on a soft secondary fill.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Say what is being closed when more than one is on screen.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button except children.
